## Data Wrangling

Key:

C = Diver Physical Clipboard
D = Diver GoPro Video
DC = Diver GoPro Video Attached to Clipboard
R = Rangerbot GoPro Video

OC = Open Circut Diver
RB = Rangerbot AUV
```{r}
OC <- read_xlsx("Data/Fish Count Data.xlsx", sheet = "OCClipboard")
# RB <- read_xlsx("Data/Fish Count Data.xlsx", sheet = "FishCountVideo")
videos <- read_xlsx("Data/Fish Count Data.xlsx", sheet = "FishCountVideo") |>  #all videos diver and rangerbot
  # filter(SurveyLocation != "GKT") |> # Dont need bc moved to DataNOTusing tab
   select(Observer, Transect:ColorPhase8) |> 
  filter(if_any(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))) #removes rows where each column is NA
 
videos$TimeStamp <- format(videos$TimeStamp, "%M:%S")#Minutes : Seconds


metadata_fish <- read_xlsx("Data/Fish Count Data.xlsx", sheet = "FishMetadata") |> 
  select("SppCode":"TrophicLevel")

OC_clean <- OC |> 
  select(SurveyLocation, SurveyDate, D_DC_R:Observer, ScientificName:TrophicGroup, '0-5':SppTotal)
```

```{r}

#   mutate(SurveyDate = as.Date(SurveyDate, format = "%d%b%Y"))

videos <- videos |> #new column with all seconds
  mutate(
    TimeStamp_sec = period_to_seconds(ms(TimeStamp))) 

#Some columns are not showing the new data 
# videos <- videos |>
#   mutate(
#     Count6 = if_else(Count6 == TRUE, NA_real_, Count6))


videos <- videos |> # new column total duration in sec of the total video (do not add this column)
  group_by(Observer, Transect, SurveyDate, SurveyLocation,D_DC_R) |>
  mutate(
    TotalDuration_sec = max(TimeStamp_sec, na.rm = TRUE) -
                    min(TimeStamp_sec, na.rm = TRUE))

videos_lng <- videos |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(Species|Count|Behaviors|ColorPhase)[1-8]$"),
    names_to = c(".value", "SpeciesNumber"),
    names_pattern = "(Species|Count|Behaviors|ColorPhase)([1-8])") |> 
  filter(!is.na(Count), Count != "") # Removes rows where the count is NA (keeps all 0)

## Cleaning Data
clean_videos_lng <- videos_lng |> 
  mutate(
    ColorPhase = case_when(
      str_detect(ColorPhase, regex("^(TERMINAL|adult|term|terinal|T)", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "terminal",
      str_detect(ColorPhase, regex("^(initial|I|intiial|iniital|intial)", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "initial",
      str_detect(ColorPhase, regex("^(juv|juvenile)", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "juvenile",
      TRUE ~ ColorPhase)) 

count_vid <- clean_videos_lng |> 
  group_by(SurveyDate, SurveyLocation, Observer, D_DC_R, Transect, TotalDuration_sec, Species) |>
  summarise(
    TotalSppCount = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

metadata_lookup <- metadata_fish |>
  select(SppCode, CommonName, ScientificName:TrophicLevel) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(SppCode, CommonName),
    names_to = "match_type",
    values_to = "Species")

count_vid_sp <- count_vid |> 
  left_join(metadata_lookup, by = join_by(Species == Species), relationship = "many-to-many", na_matches = "never")

count_vid_spp <- count_vid_sp |> 
  left_join(metadata_fish |> 
              select(ScientificName, CommonName), by = join_by(ScientificName == ScientificName), relationship = "many-to-many", na_matches = "never")
  

fish_per_df <- count_vid_spp |>  # Not by species
  group_by(SurveyDate, SurveyLocation, Observer, D_DC_R, Transect, TotalDuration_sec) |>
  summarise(
    TotalCount = sum(TotalSppCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") 

fish_per_df <- fish_per_df %>%
  drop_na()

fish_per_df$TotalDuration_min <- fish_per_df$TotalDuration_sec/60

    labs(
    y = "Fish Abundance (Video)",
    x = "Diver (D) vs Rangerbot (R) per transect")

## Physical Clipboard Surveys
clipboard <- OC_clean |> 
  group_by(SurveyDate, SurveyLocation, Transect, D_DC_R, SpeciesCode) |>
  summarize(
    total_counts = sum(SppTotal, na.rm = TRUE), # the NA means that there were fish in the frame at that point but they were the same fish counted in the frame before, therefore removing the NA ensures there is no double counting of fish.
    .groups = "drop"

clipboard <- clipboard |> 
  mutate(`D/R` = ifelse(`D/R` == "D", "C", `D/R`))

clipboard <- clipboard |>

clipboard <- clipboard |> 
  select(SurveyDate:TrophicLevel) |> 
  filter(!is.na(total_counts)) |> 
  mutate(SurveyDate = as.Date(SurveyDate, format = "%d%b%Y"))
  
video_clipboard <- bind_rows(clipboard, count_sum)
```

## Counts Preliminary ICRS
```{r Counts}
RB_countsum<- RB_clean |> 
  group_by(SurveyDate, SurveyLocation, Transect, `D/R`) |>
  summarize(
    total_counts = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE), # the NA means that there were fish in the frame at that point but they were the same fish counted in the frame before, therefore removing the NA ensures there is no double counting of fish.
    .groups = "drop"
  )

OC_countsum <- OC_clean |> 
  group_by(SurveyDate, SurveyLocation, Transect, `D/R`) |>
  summarize(
    total_counts = sum(SppTotal, na.rm = TRUE), # the NA means that there were fish in the frame at that point but they were the same fish counted in the frame before, therefore removing the NA ensures there is no double counting of fish.
    .groups = "drop"
  )

combined <- bind_rows(
  slice(OC_countsum, c(4, 5)),
  slice(RB_countsum, c(3, 5)))
  
### BIT and BPT one transect each
ggplot(combined, aes(x = `D/R`, y = total_counts, fill = `D/R`)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  facet_wrap(~SurveyLocation, labeller = labeller(SurveyLocation = c(
    BIT = "Buck Island, St. Thomas, USVI",
    BPT = "Black Point, St. Thomas, USVI")))+
  labs(
    x = "Diver vs. AUV",
    y = "Total Fish Count", 
    caption = str_wrap("Figure 1. Comparison of total fish counts recorded during one transect by a diver and AUV at Buck Island and Black Point, St. Thomas, USVI.", width = 100)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "D" = "#2c695c",
    "R" = "#f4e5b5"))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "D" = "Diver",
    "R" = "AUV")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(combined$total_counts), by = 50))+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 22),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 15)
  )

ggsave("Outputs/Figures/BIT_BPT_Abundance_AprMay26.png", plot = last_plot(), dpi = 300) 


### Separated by species BIT one transect only

    .groups = "drop"

OC_countsumsp <- OC_clean |>

OC_countsumsp <- OC_countsumsp |>
```

## Size & frequency
```{r}
OC_size <- OC |> 
  select(SurveyLocation, SurveyDate, 'D/R', Transect, ScientificName:SppTotal) |> 
  # filter(SurveyLocation == "BIT") |> 
  rename(c( `6-10`= `46183.0`, `11-20` = `46346.0`))

OC_long <- pivot_longer(OC_size, cols = `0-5`:`>150`, names_to = "Size (cm)", values_to = "count")

OC_long$`Size (cm)` <- factor(OC_long$`Size (cm)`, levels = c("0-5", "6-10", "11-20", "21-30", "31-40", "41-50", "51-60",   "61-70", "71-80", "81-90", "91-100", "101-110", "111-120", "121-130", "131-140", "141-150", ">150"))

OC_long$TransectDate <- paste(OC_long$SurveyDate, OC_long$Transect, sep = " Transect ")

OC_long <- OC_long |> na.omit()

# frequency of fish in size bins for OC counts BIT only on 5/13
ggplot(OC_long, aes(x = TransectDate, y = count, fill = `Size (cm)`))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")+
  labs(x = "Diver Transect number",
       y= "total fish count",
       title = "Buck Island St. Thomas total fish count from Diver surveys per date and transect colored by fish size (cm)")+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25) 
  )
ggsave("Outputs/Figures/Diver_AbundanceSize_AprMay26.png", plot = last_plot(), dpi = 300) 

##Large fish Diver vs all count RB

RB_sum$TransectDate <- paste(RB_sum$SurveyDate, RB_sum$Transect, sep = " Transect ")

OC_long13 <- OC_long |>

  group_by(SurveyDate, SurveyLocation, Transect, `D/R`, TransectDate) |>
  summarize(
    total_counts = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

OC13 <- ggplot(OC_long13, aes(x = TransectDate, y = total_counts))+

OC13
```

##fish per min
```{r}

RB_min <- RB_clean |> 
  filter(SurveyLocation == "BIT") |> 
  mutate(`Time (sec)` = period_to_seconds(ms(TimeStamp)))|>
  group_by(SurveyDate, SurveyLocation, Transect, `D/R`) |> 
  summarize(
   `Time (sec)` = max(`Time (sec)`) - min(`Time (sec)`), #this is to get the total length of the video analized
   `Time (min)` = `Time (sec)`/60 )

RB_min$total_count <- RB_sum$total_counts

RB_min$TransectDate <- paste(RB_min$SurveyDate, RB_min$Transect, sep = " Transect ")

RB_min$FishperMin <- RB_min$total_count/RB_min$`Time (min)`

OC_min <- OC_countsum |> 
  filter(SurveyLocation == "BIT")

OC_min$FishperMin <- OC_min$total_counts/12 #~15 min diver surveys

OC_min$TransectDate <- paste(OC_min$SurveyDate, OC_min$Transect, sep = " Transect ")


OCMin <- ggplot(OC_min, aes(x = TransectDate, y = FishperMin))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +  
  labs(x = "Diver Transect number",
       y= "Fish per Minute",
       title = "Diver Buck Island St. Thomas")+
  ylim(0,50)+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25) 
  )
OCMin

RBMin <- ggplot(RB_min, aes(x = TransectDate, y = FishperMin))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +  
  labs(x = "Rangerbot Transect number",
       y= "Fish per Minute",
       title = "Rangerbot Buck Island St. Thomas")+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25) 
  )
RBMin

RBMin + OCMin

ggsave("Outputs/Figures/Fish_per_min_May.png", plot = last_plot(), dpi = 300) 

OCmin <- OC_min |> 
  group_by(SurveyLocation, `D/R`) |> 
  summarize(
    avg = mean(FishperMin),
    sd_ = sd(FishperMin),
    SEM_ = sd(FishperMin) / sqrt(length(FishperMin)),
    CI_low = avg - 1.96*SEM_, # Finding Confidence Interval
    CI_high = avg + 1.96*SEM_
  )

RBmin <- RB_min |> 
  group_by(SurveyLocation, `D/R`) |> 
  summarize(
    avg = mean(FishperMin),
    sd_ = sd(FishperMin),
    SEM_ = sd(FishperMin) / sqrt(length(FishperMin)),
    CI_low = avg - 1.96*SEM_, # Finding Confidence Interval
    CI_high = avg + 1.96*SEM_
  )

combined_min <- bind_rows(
  slice(OCmin, c(1)),
  slice(RBmin, c(1)))

Fish_per_min_BIT <- ggplot(combined_min, aes(x = `D/R`, y = avg, fill = `D/R`)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg - SEM_, ymax = avg + SEM_),
                width = .2,
                position = position_dodge(.9)) +
  facet_wrap(~SurveyLocation, labeller = labeller(SurveyLocation = c(
    BIT = "Buck Island, St. Thomas, USVI")))+
  labs(
    y = "Fish Count per Minute") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "D" = "#2c695c",
    "R" = "#f4e5b5"))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "D" = "Diver (~15 min., n = 4)",
    "R" = "AUV (~2 min., n = 2)")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text("none"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 22),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 15),
    
  )
Fish_per_min_BIT
ggsave("Outputs/Figures/Fish_per_min_BIT_13May26.png", plot = Fish_per_min_BIT, dpi = 300)
```
